segments.ja298:1.1: Udumbarā cime pakkā, nigrodhā ca kapitthanā;
segments.ja298:1.3: Ehi nikkhama bhuñjassu, kiṃ jighacchāya miyyasi.
segments.ja298:2.1: Evaṃ so suhito hoti, yo vuḍḍhamapacāyati;
segments.ja298:3.1: Yaṃ vanejo vanejassa, vañceyya kapino kapi;
segments.ja298:3.3: Daharo kapi [daharopi taṃ na (sī. pī.), daharopi na (syā.)] saddheyya, na hi jiṇṇo jarākapīti.
